final: WITH feature_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, SUM(traitcount) OVER () as total_traits, COUNT(*) OVER () as total_records FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), with_share AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, total_traits, total_records, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / total_traits as share, 1.0 / total_records as avg_share FROM feature_stats), filtered AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, avg_share, share - avg_share as margin FROM with_share WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, margin FROM filtered ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
